scope: the selected 9990-N_F run versus the same setting's completed 4080-N_F run on the frozen remote reference host

cross_host_short_runs.reason: the pre-4080 selected shorter trajectories were produced on the local Mac; the staged protocol does not assume cross-host bitwise identity

required_identity_before_comparison: physical oracle and source closure SHA-256
alpha, r, m_max, eta, history, tangent, reparameterization, storage, thread, and endpoint controls
remote reference host and one-thread execution policy
comparison_domain: every fully reparameterization-committed state in the 4080 result, ordered by its actual optimization Number of Forces; wall time and any terminal uncommitted charged partial tail are excluded
exact_tests: the eligible optimization-N_F sequence is an exact prefix of the 9990 eligible sequence
each corresponding stored 32-image Cartesian path is byte-identical after canonical little-endian float64 serialization
each corresponding discrete I_perp value and all online state/history arrays are byte-identical
endpoint getState attempts and endpoint cache misses remain zero in both runs
failure_rule: any exact-prefix mismatch blocks the formal 9990 claim and is reported; no result-dependent tolerance or replacement setting is permitted
